The 2026 Emmy Awards will officially feature a special tribute to Dolly Parton, honoring the country music legend just weeks after her passing at the age of 80. 

Producers behind the 78th Emmys confirmed that a dedicated segment celebrating Dolly’s life and television legacy is currently being prepared, although exact details are being kept under wraps. 

Dolly had a long connection to television beyond her music, starring in variety specials, appearing across major shows and even earning an Emmy as a producer during her decades long career. 

The ceremony will also feature Noah Kahan performing “Bridge Over Troubled Water” during the annual In Memoriam segment, which will honor other television figures lost over the past year. 

The 78th Emmy Awards air September 14 on NBC and Peacock, and Dolly Parton will receive one final television tribute on one of the industry’s biggest nights.

BREAKING: RANSOM CANYON has officially been cancelled by Netflix after two seasons, meaning there will be no Season 3

despite the writers previously beginning work on another chapter. Your screenshot shows fresh reports from Deadline, TVLine, Netflix Life and Just Jared all confirming it.

Josh Duhamel and Minka Kelly led the romantic Western as Staten and Quinn, with Season 2 continuing the ranching drama, family conflicts and relationship storylines in Texas.

The cancellation is especially surprising because the creative team had already discussed Season 3 plans and had begun working in the writers’ room earlier this summer. 

RANSOM CANYON officially ends after two seasons on Netflix, leaving several storylines without the third chapter that had already started being planned.

Crew Girl stars Miku Martineau as Teagan Tao, a teenage rowing prodigy who steps into a prep school boys' crew as their outspoken coxswain following a family scandal. The coming-of-age series follows the team's dynamic on and off the water alongside a cast featuring Samuel Braun, Kyle Clark, and Jessica Paré.

Lizzie Borden is coming to Netflix next week. 

MONSTER: THE LIZZIE BORDEN STORY premieres September 17, bringing the infamous 19th century murder case to the screen in the latest installment of the MONSTER anthology series.

The new season will explore the story of Lizzie Borden and the events surrounding the murders that made her one of the most notorious figures in American history.

With the premiere just around the corner, Netflix is preparing to bring another chilling true crime story to viewers.

Judi Dench has revealed that her eyesight has deteriorated so severely that she can no longer recognize people, watch television or read. 

The 91 year old acting legend has lived with age related macular degeneration since 2012, a condition that gradually damages central vision and has increasingly affected her everyday life. 

Dench explained that she can sometimes make out a person’s outline but cannot properly recognize faces anymore, even during a recent interview alongside longtime friend Ian McKellen. 

Her worsening eyesight has also made acting much more difficult, with Dench previously revealing that she relies on other people to read scripts aloud and helps herself learn lines through repetition. 

After one of the most celebrated careers in British acting, Judi Dench is now facing a heartbreaking reality where the stage, screen and even familiar faces have become increasingly difficult for her to see.

THE VAMPIRE DIARIES premiered 17 years ago today on September 10, 2009, introducing Mystic Falls, the Salvatore brothers and one of television’s most famous supernatural love triangles. 

Nina Dobrev starred as Elena Gilbert alongside Paul Wesley as Stefan Salvatore and Ian Somerhalder as Damon, with the pilot beginning Elena’s complicated connection to the two vampire brothers. 

The series would eventually expand far beyond that original romance, building an entire mythology around vampires, witches, werewolves, hybrids and the Mikaelson family.

THE VAMPIRE DIARIES ran for eight seasons before ending in 2017, while its world later continued through THE ORIGINALS and LEGACIES. 

Seventeen years later, it is hard to believe the entire Mystic Falls era started with one pilot episode airing on The CW on September 10, 2009.

ONE WEEK until MONSTER: THE LIZZIE BORDEN STORY arrives on NETFLIX!

The fourth instalment of Ryan Murphy and Ian Brennan’s ‘MONSTER’ series will depict the infamous 1892 case that shocked America.

Ella Beatty stars as Lizzie Borden, the woman accused of brutally killing her father and stepmother with a hatchet inside their Massachusetts home. She was later acquitted, but the murders remain unsolved more than 130 years later.

All eight episodes drop September 17.

WHY DID I GET MARRIED AGAIN? is now officially streaming on Netflix, bringing Tyler Perry’s beloved group back together 16 years after WHY DID I GET MARRIED TOO? 

The new movie reunites the couples for a destination wedding in Lake Como, Italy, where Marcus and Angela’s daughter Jasmine is preparing to marry Wesley. 

Tyler Perry, Jill Scott, Tasha Smith, Michael Jai White, Sharon Leal, Lamman Rucker and Richard T. Jones all return, while Taraji P. Henson joins the franchise as Roselyn. 

As the wedding weekend begins, old secrets, complicated relationships and familiar bad habits start resurfacing, threatening to turn the celebration into complete chaos. 

WHY DID I GET MARRIED AGAIN? is now streaming on Netflix, and the original crew is officially back together for another messy round of love, marriage and drama.

Nicolas Cage is 62 and his wife Riko Shibata is 31, making their 31 year age gap even more surprising when you realize she is younger than Cage’s eldest son, Weston, who is 35. 

Cage and Shibata first met in Japan in 2019 while he was filming PRISONERS OF THE GHOSTLAND, and their relationship continued long distance during the pandemic. 

The pair married in Las Vegas in February 2021 after Cage proposed over FaceTime and sent her a customized black diamond engagement ring. 

They later welcomed their daughter, August Francesca, in September 2022, giving Cage his third child and Shibata her first. 

Their age difference has attracted plenty of attention over the years, but Nicolas Cage and Riko Shibata have now been married for more than five years and continue to make occasional public appearances together.

Happy 60th birthday to Adam Sandler, born September 9, 1966, and still one of the most recognizable comedy stars Hollywood has ever produced. 

From BILLY MADISON and HAPPY GILMORE to THE WATERBOY, 50 FIRST DATES, GROWN UPS and UNCUT GEMS, Sandler has spent decades jumping between ridiculous comedy and surprisingly powerful dramatic roles. 

His career has now stretched across nearly 40 years, including Saturday Night Live, blockbuster comedies, Netflix hits and major dramatic performances that completely changed how people viewed him as an actor. 

60 years old and still making movies people instantly recognize as “an Adam Sandler movie.” Happy birthday to one of comedy’s true icons.

Eight years ago today, YOU premiered on Lifetime on September 9, 2018, introducing Penn Badgley as Joe Goldberg for the very first time. 

The first season followed Joe, a New York bookstore manager whose obsession with aspiring writer Guinevere Beck quickly turned into stalking, manipulation and murder. 

Penn Badgley starred alongside Elizabeth Lail, Shay Mitchell, Luca Padovan and Zach Cherry, with the first season running for 10 episodes on Lifetime. 

The series later moved to Netflix beginning with Season 2, where it exploded into a much bigger global hit and continued for five seasons in total. 

Eight years later, it is wild to remember that Joe Goldberg’s entire twisted story started on Lifetime before YOU became one of Netflix’s most recognizable thrillers.

The aristocrats are back, but with a smaller launch audience. Early viewing data for The Gentlemen Season 2 logged 6.7 million views over its opening weekend, marking a 45% drop compared to the 12.2 million views brought in by Season 1.

Jim Geoghan, the co creator of THE SUITE LIFE OF ZACK & CODY, has passed away at the age of 79, marking the loss of one of the people behind an entire generation of Disney Channel childhoods.

Geoghan created the series alongside Danny Kallis, helping bring Zack, Cody, London Tipton, Maddie and Mr. Moseby to life across three seasons and 87 episodes. 

His work also continued into THE SUITE LIFE ON DECK, extending the world he helped build into one of Disney Channel’s most recognizable franchises. 

For millions who grew up inside the Tipton Hotel every afternoon, Jim Geoghan helped create a piece of childhood television that will stay around long after him.

The Odyssey is reportedly on track to make box office history by becoming the first film ever to earn more than $500 million from IMAX screenings alone.

Do you think IMAX has become a major reason behind the movie’s success?

Netflix has unveiled the first look images from ‘LUPIN’ Season 4, giving fans an exciting new glimpse at the return of Omar Sy as the iconic master thief Assane Diop.

The newly released images offer an early look at the next chapter of the hit series as Assane prepares for another thrilling adventure filled with danger, mystery and unexpected twists.

‘LUPIN’ has become one of Netflix’s biggest international hits, with Omar Sy’s charismatic performance at the heart of the series’ global success. Now, fans are finally getting their first look at what Season 4 has in store.

The master thief is getting ready to return, and a new chapter of ‘LUPIN’ is officially on the way.
